mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we have clear skies near Verona Area High School and a Waning Gibbous moon to look forward to, and if you look northwest near the high school at 5:03 PM, you can catch the space station for 6 minutes as it travels east toward Fitchburg and rises halfway up the sky.

City Hall is reminding residents that nomination papers for the 2027 spring aldermanic election can be filed until January 5th, and please note that property tax bills will be arriving in the mail no later than December 15th.
It is a busy season, with The Crafty Fair occurring today, followed by live music at Lake Lou-ee tomorrow and yoga sessions starting November 30.
In a report covering November 1 through 15, on November 2, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on West End Circle that resulted in an arrest for battery and disorderly conduct.
Mint Cookie is today's featured flavor at Culver's, and since the restaurant is open until 10:30 PM, there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
